title: D2: scouts on a budget — 12 turns, 800-token results, haiku for enumeration, none below complexity 5, recall before scouting
spec:
Why: 8 sonnet scouts cost 4.59 USD on 2026-09-18 (about 720k cache-read tokens each over 20 turns), several re-derived what memory or a grep would have answered. Changes: (1) .orchestrator/pool.toml: limits.max_turns.scout 20 to 12, max_budget_usd.scout 2.0 to 1.0, timeout_s.scout 900 to 600, with a comment. (2) .orchestrator/prompts/scout.md: open with "Run `bash skills/planner/memory/scripts/recall.sh index <terms>` first and cite hits instead of re-deriving"; results are at most 800 tokens, findings as one line each with path:line and confidence, no prose summary beyond two sentences; stop as soon as every acceptance line is answered. (3) Planner rules in both copies of the orchestrate skill (.claude/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md and skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md, keep them byte-identical): no scouts for goals of complexity 4 or less (the Planner greps); at most two scouts per goal unless plan.md names why more; enumeration scouts ("list X with path:line") go on haiku, judgement scouts on sonnet, opus only with a written reason; scout results are read once and summarised into plan.md, never re-read. (4) tests/test_hooks.py or a new small test in tests/test_pool.py asserting the two skill copies are identical and the pool limits carry the new values. README.md: one line under Pipeline.
(Recreated from T-0111: re-pointed at C-O3 v4)
acceptance: pool.toml scout limits are 12 turns, 1.0 USD, 600 s with a comment; prompts/scout.md contains the recall-first line and the 800-token cap
Both orchestrate SKILL.md copies contain the four Planner rules and a test asserts they are byte-identical
`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` green

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0121`, tests green.

**Summary:** Tightened scout limits (turns 20→12, budget $2.0→$1.0, timeout 900s→600s) in `pool.toml`; added a recall-first line and an 800-token/one-line-per-finding cap to `scout.md`; added four Planner rules to `orchestrate/SKILL.md` (no scouts below complexity 5, max 2 scouts unless justified in plan.md, haiku for enumeration/sonnet for judgement/opus needs a written reason, scout results read once into plan.md and never re-read) — the two SKILL.md copies are hardlinked so the edit applied to both atomically; added tests asserting the pool limits and file identity; added one README line under Pipeline.

**Files changed:** `.orchestrator/pool.toml`, `.orchestrator/prompts/scout.md`, `skills/planner/orchestrate/SKILL.md` (+ its hardlinked twin `.claude/skills/orchestrate/SKILL.md`), `tests/test_pool.py`, `README.md`.

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → 158 tests, OK (no failures). `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exit 0.
